organization.name_ja: 株式会社サカタのタネ

affected.note: Sum of the category figures in the 2026-08-19 final report (no overall total stated): about 44,000 wholesale customers and business partners, about 2,500 campaign applicants, about 5,000 job applicants and candidates, about 5,000 employees and former employees, and about 200 other business partners. A separate 2026 intrusion at the US subsidiary is not included.

summary.en: Sakata Seed detected an intrusion into its servers and confirmed on 2025-11-11 that some data had been accessed, starting from a public remote-access server. Its final report listed about 56,700 records of customers, partners, applicants and employees that may have leaked.
summary.ja: サカタのタネは、リモートアクセス用の公開サーバーを起点とした不正侵入を感知し、2025年11月11日にデータの一部へのアクセス痕跡を確認した。最終報で、顧客、取引先、応募者、従業員などの個人情報計約5万6,700件が漏えいした可能性があると公表した。

sources.title: 当社および米国連結子会社への不正アクセス に関するご報告（最終報）
sources.publisher: 株式会社サカタのタネ
